guard: Native account update acceptance requires the pinned account and exact required server acknowledgments, not one success response
why: The internal collector runs over actual scoped system connections on two routed full resolvers, a disconnected required holder and an unloaded memory resolver. Stored claims, live eviction and new connections are independent native controls. This is acceptance collection, not host admission, signer serialization, persistence or lifecycle retirement.

mutations.name: missing required server is reported accepted
mutations.find:
if ([...required].some(id => !accepted.has(id)))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("unavailable", "native account update has missing required acknowledgments");
mutations.expectRed: missing required server refuses instead of declaring update accepted
mutations.cell: missing required server refuses instead of declaring update accepted

mutations.name: unlisted responder widens required server set
mutations.expectRed: unlisted native responder refuses rather than widening the required set
mutations.cell: unlisted native responder refuses rather than widening the required set

mutations.name: success-coded skipped update is counted as acceptance
mutations.expectRed: native skipped response is success-coded but is not an update acknowledgment
mutations.cell: native skipped response is success-coded but is not an update acknowledgment

mutations.name: duplicate required coordinates are admitted
mutations.expectRed: duplicate required server IDs refuse before native publish
mutations.cell: duplicate required server IDs refuse before native publish

mutations.name: foreign account claim reaches native publish
mutations.expectRed: foreign account claim refuses before native publish
mutations.cell: foreign account claim refuses before native publish

mutations.name: zero wait budget reaches native publish
